Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left-hand lane on a Pearland, Texas roadway when the vehicle moved over to the right
lane without a visible signal, contacting the side of Driver 2's vehicle as it passed. Driver 1 reported pain in the right
shoulder following the impact and was assessed at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the type and
force of a sideswipe collision of this kind. Both vehicles displayed scrape marks and paint transfer along the right side
of Driver 1's vehicle and the left rear quarter panel of Driver 2's vehicle, and the damage pattern matches the impact
described by both drivers. Photographs taken at the scene confirm the general positions of the vehicles and the
damage observed. No independent witnesses were located who saw the collision itself. Officers confirmed that the
Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of the crash, a fact also confirmed by Driver 2. No prior damage to
Driver 1's vehicle was known to either party or noted during the inspection. Driver 1 is listed as an insured driver on
the policy covering the vehicle.
